title: RpcErrorData
description: Payload carried in the `data` member of a JSON-RPC error object. The host never sends user-facing prose across the bridge: it sends a stable code plus arguments, and the renderer resolves them through its string catalogue.

code.description: Stable, lower_snake_case error identifier. Part of the contract: renaming one is a breaking change.

args.description: Named substitution values for the resolved message.
